notes: The served counts match the reported patients with serious adverse events: 28 in the tocilizumab group and 12 in the placebo group. The source separately reports 36 and 38 serious adverse event occurrences, respectively; these are not participant counts. Denominators 161 and 82 are stated in Table 4, Adverse Events in the Safety Population. One placebo patient intubated before receiving placebo was included in the safety population but excluded from the modified intention-to-treat population. Percentages for patients with any serious adverse event and an explicit assessment window for these safety counts are NOT_IN_PACKET; the 28-day follow-up wording elsewhere concerns efficacy outcomes.
